{{Top|leg}}
An '''audio coding chip''' was a sound recording device that could be installed in [[Datapad/Legends|datapads]]. The [[MicroData Technologies/Legends|MicroData Technologies]] [[Pocket Secretary]] had an internal audio coding chip installed which allowed spoken messages to be transcribed into computer data.
